what_was_measured: Matched vs moved captions on Flickr30k test images. NOT news data; see the module docstring.
interpretation: Similarity separates a caption written for an image from one moved to another image well above chance; the gap is smaller for captions that resemble the true one. Most pairs land in 'unclear' by design (the thresholds demand 95% precision). These are everyday photos; real news out-of-context pairs are harder and were not tested.
